invariants.rationale: If className were null or empty, projectClassInfo.get(className) would likely fail or return null, causing a runtime exception.
classProperties is used for storing properties. It must be non-null for proper operation.
classElement is used to look up properties with getPropertyByName; a null element would make property extraction impossible.
After loading, classProperties should have at least one property reflecting loaded class members.
If classProperties has any keys, it may contain 'type' when a 'class' property is loaded; otherwise, it may be empty.
